title: Aligning AI Teams
abstract: arXiv:2611.17820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams. We focus on two software-engineering tasks (sepsis triage, a news recommender) and ten consulting-proposal generation tasks. We present four findings: (1) The single-vs-team safety gap does not show a clear trend with more capable models. We find that Anthropic's Mythos Preview shows the largest gap on one of our tasks but the smallest on another; (2) Many natural interventions, such as having agents critique each other's work or coordinate in a group chat, do not reliably bring agent teams back to single-agent alignment behavior; (3) diffusion of responsibility substantially accounts for the safety gap: agents in teams are less likely to proactively check for system-level safety f

translated_abstract: 先前的研究表明，针对单个LLM智能体进行的对齐训练可能无法迁移到多智能体环境中。我们研究了这种失败的底层机制，并探索了在对齐迁移到多智能体LLM团队时保持对齐的干预措施。我们聚焦于两个软件工程任务（脓毒症分诊、新闻推荐器）和十个咨询提案生成任务。我们提出了四项发现：（1）单体与团队之间的安全差距并未随着模型能力的增强而呈现明显趋势。我们发现Anthropic的Mythos Preview在其中一个任务上表现出最大的差距，但在另一个任务上却表现出最小的差距；（2）许多自然的干预措施，例如让智能体相互批评彼此的工作或在群聊中进行协调，并不能可靠地使智能体团队恢复到单体智能体的对齐行为；（3）责任分散在很大程度上解释了安全差距：团队中的智能体不太可能主动检查系统级的安全故障……（摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了单个LLM智能体的对齐训练难以迁移到多智能体团队的机制，发现责任分散是安全差距的主要成因，而相互批评、群聊协调等常见自然干预措施无法可靠地恢复团队的对齐行为。
en_tdlr: This study investigates why alignment training on individual LLM agents fails to transfer to multi-agent teams, finding that diffusion of responsibility substantially accounts for the safety gap and that natural interventions like peer critique or group-chat coordination do not reliably restore team alignment.
